notes: Resolver (protocol section 6). The assessors agreed on every criterion (I1 false; I2-I4 null; I5 true) and on eligible = false; the only disagreement is the exclusion code. Code order in the section 4 table: theoretical_only and electrochemical do not apply (experimental work, gas-phase H2 treatments), and not_carbon does not apply because I2 is not assessed when I1 fails. not_primary precedes no_conditions_stated, so it decides. The document is a chapter (ch. 5) of an edited InTech book ('Advances in Diverse Industrial Applications of Nanocomposites', 2011) that re-presents the authors' earlier journal results: every data figure and the reaction model are attributed to prior articles (Fig. 1: Ichikawa et al., 2005 and Miyaoka et al., 2009; Fig. 2, Figs. 6-7 and Eqs. 1-13: Miyaoka et al., 2009; Figs. 3-5: Miyaoka et al., 2008; Figs. 8-10: Miyaoka et al., 2007), and both sample preparation and the analyses are deferred to 'the previous articles' / 'the articles reported before'. No result is presented as new. It is therefore a review of the group's own published work and is coded not_primary. Considered against: the chapter does not call itself a review, keeps a research-article layout (Experimental details, Results and discussion), and says the model 'would describe the experimental results obtained in this work' (PDF p. 11, printed p. 89); this does not outweigh the explicit attribution of every figure to earlier publications. Had not_primary not applied, the code would be no_conditions_stated (I1 failure that is neither theory nor electrochemistry): the only hydrogen amounts are TG weight losses on heating after reactor rehydrogenation at 350 C and 3.0 MPa H2, with no measured gravimetric, volumetric or flow uptake. Informational: no specific surface area appears anywhere in the chapter. Assessor A's exclusion quote was found verbatim at the stated location (PDF p. 2, printed p. 80, Section 1); A's and B's I5 quote was found at PDF p. 1.
